historical_clock_law.first_known: not reconstructable before the W-LIQ.1 producer existed; historical rows are not episode timestamps
historical_clock_law.observation_and_release: reconstructed conservatively from economic reference dates and configured date-only lags

pit_policy: economic reference date plus conservative business-day release lag; expanding transforms use only prior observations

revision_law.changed_source_or_model: emit a new snapshot and data/model version; never rewrite a downstream first-known episode
revision_law.episode_amendments: owned by W-LIQ.3 append-only ledgers, not this producer
revision_law.exact_retry: same hash is the same immutable source snapshot and preserves its earliest published first_known_at
